issues.on_page: Budget and Actual - All Funds expenditure lines for funds with no other schedule: Streets 170,156 (budget 3,618,750), Keno 4,349 (12,725), Economic Development 225 (498,533), Water 226,783 (1,214,500), Wastewater 83,529 (2,647,150), Sanitation 180,023 (163,710)
issues.issue: Only the General Fund departments schedule (pp11-12) is in detail. The extractor rule says that when a more detailed schedule exists for one fund only, the budget schedule's lines are still recorded for every other fund, including utility funds. These six function lines each name a single fund. The revenue lines and the 'Principal and interest' line on p10 are combined across funds and can stay out.
Recycling fees are refuse/sanitation charges (detail_category says so), and refuse belongs to the Utility Charges receipt category.

issues.on_page: NPPD lease 348,429 (Statement of Activities: NPPD franchise fees)
issues.issue: The statement calls it a lease and the Statement of Activities calls it a franchise fee. Franchise is defensible, but it could also be Rentals.

issues.on_page: Total fund balance 1,460,175 (includes Due from Water and Sewer 70,486, p3)
issues.issue: The governmental 'cash' roll-forward is the modified-cash fund balance, which includes a 70,486 interfund receivable that isn't cash. Beginning cash 1,208,690 is on the same basis.
The department interest-income lines add to 55,220 against a printed Total of 55,221. This is a 1-dollar rounding gap in the report, and report_discrepancies doesn't record it.
